arguments.sql: SELECT products.name AS Produkt, SUM(order_lines.quantity) AS Menge, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Betrag FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE products.line = 'Spare parts' AND YEAR(orders.order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY products.name;
